body.x: Polar Electro unveiled a fitness tracker, ‘A360’ at the world’s best IT technology exhibition ‘CES(Consumer Technology Show) 2016’ which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas Convention Center(LVCC).A360 plays a role in a private trainer, checking user’s heart rate.
